_comment: Cached AI explanations for demo-repo/broken fixtures. Used by --format text|json during recorded demos so the video never depends on live Bedrock availability/latency. Keyed by 'rule_id:resource_id'. Regenerate with: python -m explain.regenerate_cache

R1-S3-PUBLIC:DataLakeBucket.explanation: This bucket has no public access block and an ACL that allows public read, so anyone on the internet can list or download its contents.
R1-S3-PUBLIC:DataLakeBucket.suggested_fix: Enable all four S3 Block Public Access settings and remove the public-read ACL.
R1-S3-PUBLIC:DataLakeBucket.fix_snippet:
PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
  BlockPublicAcls: true
  BlockPublicPolicy: true
  IgnorePublicAcls: true
  RestrictPublicBuckets: true

R2-IAM-WILDCARD-ACTION:AdminRolePolicy.explanation: This policy's Action is set to '*', granting every AWS API action across every service to anything that assumes this role.
R2-IAM-WILDCARD-ACTION:AdminRolePolicy.suggested_fix: List only the specific actions the workload actually needs, e.g. s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject.

R3-IAM-WILDCARD-RESOURCE:DataPipelinePol.explanation: The Resource element is '*', so the S3 actions apply to every bucket in the account, not just the ones this ETL pipeline actually owns.
R3-IAM-WILDCARD-RESOURCE:DataPipelinePol.suggested_fix: Scope Resource to the specific bucket ARN(s) the pipeline needs to touch.

R4-SG-OPEN-INGRESS:DatabaseSecurityGroup.explanation: PostgreSQL (5432) and SSH (22) are both open to 0.0.0.0/0, meaning the database is directly reachable and brute-forceable from anywhere on the internet.
R4-SG-OPEN-INGRESS:DatabaseSecurityGroup.suggested_fix: Restrict both ingress rules to a known VPC range or bastion security group instead of 0.0.0.0/0.

R5-NO-MFA-CONDITION:SecurityAuditPolicy.explanation: Sensitive IAM actions like CreateUser and AttachRolePolicy are permitted with no MFA condition, so a leaked credential alone is enough to use them.
R5-NO-MFA-CONDITION:SecurityAuditPolicy.suggested_fix: Require aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent on any policy statement granting sensitive/destructive IAM actions.
